subject: planner: move base physical plan into physicalop pkg. (#55131)
summary: Refactor-only move of core base physical plan logic into pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop.BasePhysicalPlan, plus util function-pointer wiring (pkg/planner/util/utilfuncp) to avoid import cycles. Verified critical invariants are preserved: BasePhysicalPlan.Self is set in all Init paths (physicalop.NewBasePhysicalPlan(..., &p, ...); and special Index*Join wrappers set Self directly), plan-cache cloning updates Self to the cloned node (CloneForPlanCacheWithSelf and generated clones like PhysicalIndexHashJoin), and Attach2Task / probe-parent helpers are safely routed via utilfuncp assignments in pkg/planner/core/core_init.go. Later history up to upstream/master shows continued refactoring in this area; no follow-up fix suggests a correctness/semantics regression originating from this commit.
